flags.reason: misreads-source: The guide's In context only gives the text "Goa trip | 4 friends · 12 expenses" and says "Settle up is the screen’s own Button." Nothing cited says this header is a Coin `Title` component with `title`/`subtitle` props, or that the screen is built from nested VStacks. The description's "under the screen's Title" and the code add that structure without support.

notes: The anatomy alwaysPresent values are inconsistent. Currency is marked false because a slotted Money Value replaces the default one, but that replaces the Amount too, and Amount is marked true. The hidden-amount example also shows "•••" with no symbol. A human should decide what alwaysPresent means for parts of the nested Money Value. Separately, facts/props/1 is stamped evidence 2026-10-19 and gives the default "50,000.67". The 19 October contract section lists the source default as "500"; 50,000.67 comes from the 28 October dbe0e02 section. The default is read from package types, so it is not flagged, but the date stamp may be stale.
